description: Firefly III is a free and open-source personal finance manager to track expenses, income, budgets, and bills. This template defaults to SQLite for a self-contained single-container setup; set DB_CONNECTION and the related DB_* variables to use an external MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL container instead.
